answer: Synchronized presence ceremonies issue one reward credential per person. A shared beacon starts overlapping, in-person checks at all venues: attending oasis prevents the same person from also appearing at timber. Verify a signed attendance credential and consume its epoch claim once. N reward quotas then require recruiting N people, with their time or hiring cost, rather than creating N keys. This assumes honest attendance checks and simultaneous sessions; bribed staff or credential rentals remain bypasses.
